sTrack 3.0 User Manual

Offline Gantt, board, sprints and timesheet · Click any picture to enlarge

1. Getting started

  1. Run sTrack.exe (Windows 10/11) or open sTrack-web.html in a browser. Fully offline.
  2. Pick Sutora's look → Let's start.
  3. Alt+N → guided, empty, easy sample or full sample.
  4. Alt+S → working days, MH/day, holidays.
  5. Plan on the Gantt, track on Board / Sprints / Timesheet, save with Ctrl+S.

Data lives in %LOCALAPPDATA%\sTrack (exe) or a shared team file. Saved plans use .strack.json.

4. Gantt

  • Insert add · Enter next · Alt+→ indent (8 levels) · right-click for more.
  • F2 details: names, status, PIC, start, days, MH, Done %, actual, After rows (= arrows).
  • Empty start = after its predecessors. Weekends/holidays skipped.
  • Alt+V Plan vs Actual · Alt+B baseline · Alt+F needs attention.
PlanActualLateBaselineToday

5. Board · Sprints · Timesheet · Reports

  • Board Alt+2: drag cards or Ctrl+1…6; drag the bar for Done %.
  • Sprints Alt+3: goal, burndown, tasks.
  • Timesheet Alt+4: hours per day; Actual and/or Burndown MH; Ctrl+6 Excel.
  • Reports Alt+6: Ctrl+1 copy, Ctrl+2 PNG.

6. Team

  • Members: photo, two names, nickname, role, MH/day. Roles set rights (no passwords).
  • Schedule: weekly routine and leave · Outlook (classic) or .ics import.
  • Alt+W shared team database file.

7. Settings & export

  • Alt+S: Sat/Sun, MH/day, built-in Thai/Japanese holidays.
  • Alt+T: Basic, Dark, Starry Night, Forest, Burning.
  • Ctrl+O: open, import Excel/CSV, export Excel/CSV, save .strack.json.
  • Alt+X lock · Alt+D customer view (read-only).
